## Affected claim

Identify the theorem, lemma, equation, file, and line or section.

## Concern

State the suspected error precisely. Include all relevant assumptions and quantifiers.

## Evidence

Provide a counterexample, derivation, conflicting result, or minimal failing case.

## Consequence

Which later claims, computations, or documents may be affected?

## Tool assistance

Disclose material use of AI, CAS, proof assistants, or automated search.
